```yaml
name: Build CLI Native Archives
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: win-x64
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: osx-x64

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build
      run: dotnet build --no-restore -c Release

    - name: Test
      run: dotnet test --no-build -c Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results.trx"

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        file: test-results.trx

    - name: Pack
      run: dotnet pack --no-build -c Release -o ./artifacts

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: cli-native-${{ matrix.platform }}
        path: ./artifacts/*.nupkg
```
